title: Infinitely Many Components in Auslander--Reiten Quivers of Representation-Infinite Algebras over Perfect Fields
summary: Let $k$ be a perfect field and let $A$ be a representation-infinite finite-dimensional $k$-algebra. We prove that the Auslander--Reiten quiver of $A$ has infinitely many connected components. This establishes, for finite-dimensional algebras over perfect fields, a conjecture of Auslander, Reiten, and Smalø concerning Artin algebras. Over an algebraically closed field, the proof combines a localized polynomial representation embedding with semilinear twists induced by field automorphisms.
